steps.say: The moves that solve an equation work on an inequality too, and the greater-than sign keeps its direction because both sides shifted by the same amount.
Subtracting [[b]] leaves [[a]]x > [[rhs]]; dividing by [[a]] (a positive number, so the sign stays) gives x > [[bound]].

answer: So the solution is every x with [[solution]]: a set of numbers, not one number.
